answer: What survives to the ripple is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the relic of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sonnet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
